body.h: At the start Ben feeds Anne and Clare on pass pass self, while Anne and Clare pass three count to Ben. Anne walks across the pattern after a pass to Ben and then Clare feeds Anne and Ben on pass pass self, while Anne and Ben pass three count to Clare.
Starting pattern for Anne: Ben self self.
Starting pattern for Ben: Anne Clare self.
Starting pattern for Clare: self Ben self.
Pattern for Anne: self Clare self.
Pattern for Ben: Clare self self.
Pattern for Clare: Ben Anne self.
